correctness.rationale: The positive spring matrix contracts the homogeneous evolution exponentially; each reset is a nonexpanding projection. The stochastic convolution from the infinite past exists in second moment by this bound, is stationary, and synchronous coupling gives uniqueness and convergence of the quadratic expectations for finite-second-moment starts. With A=2a+r, the stationary equations give u=2(T_x-cv)/A, w=(T_y-cv)/b, and (a+b+r-2c²/A-c²/b)v=-c(2T_x/A+T_y/b). Multiplication by bA produces the stated strictly positive D. Stationary product balance for XY (Y has no jump and the independent noises have no mixed covariation) gives J_all=-2(cu+bv). The chord from (X,Y) to (0,Y) contributes XY, so Poisson compensation gives J_jump=rv and flow=all-jump. Independent symbolic elimination and expansion reproduce all three currents, the equal-bath ratio and the limits. For T_y<T_x the flow numerator has positive leading coefficient and negative constant, hence exactly one positive root, the reported r_f; for T_y≥T_x its linear coefficient is positive and constant nonnegative. The affine factor for the full rate starts negative and rises through zero only at T_x<T_y<2T_x, giving the claimed r_a. The equality endpoints and r>0 signs in all four sectors follow immediately; there is no assertion of a finite reversal at T_y=2T_x.
residual_risks: Expected unnormalized signed twice-area rates for this specific reset map; no inference about polar winding, arbitrary reset maps, or large deviations.

value.rationale: The choice of whether to include the actual reset movement in a signed-area measurement changes even the sign at equal temperatures and changes which temperature sector permits a reversal. The exact complete sign classification and cancellation of nonzero continuous transport by chords in the fast-reset limit quantify this observable dependence. This is a meaningful comparison for pathwise versus between-reset measurements, even though the moment technique is elementary.
residual_risks: No experimental validation, statement about equilibrium, or claim of universality beyond the specified diffusion and reset map.
